cases.case_label: L1 in SLCO1B3 intron 3 with exon 4 inversion
cases.mechanism_detail: A homozygous ~6-kb reverse-complement L1 inserted in SLCO1B3 intron 3 is accompanied by inversion of a 1,185-bp segment containing exon 4; the inverted exon loses its splice sites and is excluded from mRNA in a minigene assay, predicted to create a premature stop. The patient also carries a homozygous SLCO1B1 nonsense variant (digenic Rotor).
cases.quote: Further sequence analysis revealed that a reverse-complementary LINE-1 retrotransposon (~6 kbp) was inserted upstream of the inverted DNA fragment (Figure 2B).
